$description: Product status scale — CONVENTIONS §1. Six statuses, six colours, distinct from the three-tier semantic status scale in status.json and from the brand accents. `needs-decision` and `sold` alias the existing semantic values rather than duplicating them; `held` has no colour of its own (text-muted on surface-overlay) and is therefore not a token. Contrast measured 2026-08-31 against the tinted pill, the surface the text actually sits on.

low-confidence.$description: We are unsure what this card IS. Uncertainty, not alarm. Worst measured ratio 5.39:1 on its pill over surface-raised.

ready.$description: Staged and waiting. NOT success — green here claimed a victory that had not happened. 5.91:1.

listed.$description: Live in market. Same family as ready, one step on. 6.38:1.

needs-decision.$description: The only status that asks the seller to act. Aliases the semantic warning.

sold.$description: The only terminal state and the only filled pill. Aliases the semantic success.
